table.name: TLGNR_CONFIG
table.description: Configurable system properties and default values.

column.name: KEY
column.description: Identifier for a config entry, together with INSTANCE if set. When defining keys its recommended to follow a hierarchical concept such as module.area.attribute.case, as one would use in config files.

column.name: INSTANCE
column.description: Instance for which the value applies. Identifier in combination with KEY. If null: for alle instances/environments.

column.name: MIN_VALUE
column.description: If MIN_VALUE is not null: Admin application shall expect VALUE to be a number, and enforce VALUE >= MIN_VALUE.

column.name: MAX_VALUE
column.description: If MAX_VALUE is not null: Admin application shall expect VALUE to be a number, and enforce VALUE <= MAX_VALUE.

column.name: VALUE
column.description: Value of the property or system default. Always as text, the application transforms it into number or date or whatever the value represents. MIN/MAX_VALUE are validated by the admin application and are not enforced by the DB.

column.name: DESCRIPTION
column.description: Description of the configurable value, and explanation about the expected type in VALUE. This text can be used by an admin application as the help text/explanation for the admin user.
